analytic_force: g=H e; f_i+=g_a n_a; f_j-=g_a n_a=-gradient(U)
domain_contract: every current relation length must satisfy |x_j-x_i|>0
finite_tangent: energy Hessian=R^T H R + sum_a g_a/r_a B_a^T(I-n_a n_a^T)B_a; force Jacobian is its negative
frozen_energy: U=1/2 e^T H e; H/reference lengths/topology fixed from reference data
implementation: independent Python standard-library Decimal analytic energy/gradient/Hessian plus high-precision energy directional differences; no C++ force result is accepted as a premise
scope: read-only finite energy/force consistency; no dynamics
